summary: Certifiable framework that harmonizes HIPAA, NIST, ISO and PCI into one assessment. Three nested tiers (e1 ⊂ i1 ⊂ r2); r2 additionally scores five PRISMA maturity dimensions per control.

AICPA attestation report — the artifact US enterprise buyers ask for. Tracked against the 2017 Trust Services Criteria: 33 mandatory Common Criteria (CC1–CC9) plus the opt-in Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity and Privacy categories.
